shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at (1,4) on the left with the upper mark at x=1 on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point (1,4) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=−1. Right image: The point (1,4) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=1.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input. On the right, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input.
